description: Inspect a single EVM externally owned account (EOA) via live eth_getCode RPC to detect active Pectra EIP-7702 delegation hijacks (0xef0100...23-byte designator). Read-only, non-destructive lookup on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, or Polygon (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `address`, `network`, `delegated` (boolean), `delegate_contract` (0x address or null), `risk_score` (0-100), and `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`). Use this tool for targeted single-address EOA code checks; use `scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene` for full 8-chain token balance and dust discovery.

address.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x` followed by 40 hex chars) to inspect for EIP-7702 bytecode delegation.

network.description: Target EVM chain for live `eth_getCode` inspection (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, or `polygon`). Defaults to `base`.

name: check_eip7702_delegation
